01 / calendarWorking prototype

SHOWS

Underground metal, punk, goth, rock, and hardcore, alongside Portland's independent culture and community. Browse by date or music style, find a place, and move events into your own calendar.

02 / graphicsWorking prototype

SVG Hopper

Compose language-ready graphics with actual SVG text. Choose a vector-only composition or bring a photo, set a style, preview English and Spanish copy, and export an SVG—no design software required.

  • SVG
  • Language access
  • No-code
  • Accessible design
Try the composer ↗Explore code ↗

Independent proof of concept. Example styles are not City of Portland-approved designs; human review is still required for translations and accessibility.

03 / knittingWorking prototype

Tubes

Make colorful knitting patterns for projects worked in the round. Explore repeat math, preview the actual stitch chart, edit stitches, then save, reimport, or print your design.

  • Knitting
  • Generative patterns
  • Creative tools
  • Local-first
Design a pattern ↗Explore code ↗

An experimental stitch-count-preserving colorwork generator. Patterns are not test-knit; verify gauge and floats.
